# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with a reworked singleton lifecycle. It carries forward variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, controllable surface sampling, and expanded native assets. This is a breaking release: legacy paint APIs become compile errors, several defaults change, and Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy paint, text, glyph, and sampling APIs are now compile errors** — Long-obsolete SKPaint text/font members, paint-only text and shaping overloads, legacy filter-quality overloads, SKTypeface glyph helpers, selected run-buffer methods, and old backend-render-target constructors are removed from the reference assembly. Move text state and glyph work to SKFont, pass SKTextAlign and SKSamplingOptions explicitly, and use the documented replacement constructors and span properties. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKFont defaults to an empty typeface** — A parameterless SKFont now uses SKTypeface.Empty, so text measurement returns zero and drawing produces no glyphs until a typeface is assigned. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint and missing-family typeface defaults changed** — A new SKPaint now exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns the default face for an unknown Android family. Stop using null to detect these states; use IsEmpty where appropriate or call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when a strict missing-family result is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside Int32 range** — The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException for values outside the native 32-bit range instead of silently truncating them. Validate the offset and call Move(int). ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context for a Vulkan 1.0 instance can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the matching value; use raster or another backend on Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend interop structs changed** — GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 where applicable. GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo also gains Components and changes layout, so update manual struct initialization and native interop.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type loses its value-equality surface. Update source references and equality logic to use the new type. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — The protected setter is removed, so subclasses can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose after construction. Supply the disposal policy through the constructor path instead. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets removed** — The WebAssembly packages no longer include native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **32-bit Tizen native assets removed** — The EOL tizen-arm and tizen-x86 assets are no longer shipped. Move Tizen applications to tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Assembly version moved to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks.

## Engine

- **Skia updated from m119 to m148** — The bundled engine advances through m132, m133, and m147 to m148, bringing newer image-codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, and upstream raster, region, runtime-effect, and filter fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **RF16 color type** — SKColorType.RF16 exposes Skia's single-channel 16-bit half-float red format for raster and GPU workflows. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface, SKFontArguments, and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, selecting design coordinates, choosing palettes, and overriding palette colors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Sampling options for surface and bitmap draws** — New SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for explicit filtering and mipmapping. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or frame sequences to animated WebP through span-based frame APIs. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed streams** — SKStream.GetData() returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it without copying. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds SKDocument XPS creation overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, shader-backed mask filters, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and the HBColor value type. ([#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan methods now use RowBytes and the correct axis when calculating offsets and lengths, including shared-buffer subsets. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Default typeface initialization hardened** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android and NanoServer startup crashes and using an empty face when no system font is available. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))
- **Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now report and copy values correctly, and the byte-span ContainsGlyphs overload no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPath finalization crash fixed** — SKPath no longer touches a finalized SKPathBuilder when garbage-collection order disposes the builder first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android and WinUI rendering startup fixes** — SKGLView renders after MAUI TabBar reattachment, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers can resolve the packaged Projection assembly. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Process-wide wrappers initialize lazily without static-constructor cycles, no longer free shared native singletons, and remain alive across native calls. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility check delayed until first API use** — The compatibility gate now runs through the SkiaApi type initializer, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets** — Adds linux-bionic-x64, linux-bionic-arm64, tizen-x64, and tizen-arm64 assets while retiring the EOL 32-bit Tizen targets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **.NET 8 becomes the WebAssembly floor** — WebAssembly native packages retain Emscripten variants for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for older target frameworks. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Apple library target frameworks corrected** — Apple libraries target the base 26.0 platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for Xcode 26.2. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — libexpat 2.8.1 brings upstream security hardening, while libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz also move to newer bundled releases. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Bundles HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 with improved OpenType shaping and CFF2 subsetting, plus variable-font APIs, color font palette access, HBColor, and expanded Linux and Tizen native assets.
